about: Generic content schema ids (round 3, C3a; Arch #15). A schema in schemas/content/ is named by what the file is for any language (lexicon@1, phrases@1, grammar@1 ...); the ids from before, named after Igloo, the B1 trainer or the speaking app, stay valid as aliases of the generic one, so a file or tool that still names the old id validates against the same schema. tools/build-manifest.mjs writes the generic id; tools/validate-content.mjs accepts either. An exam's test and explanation files keep the exam's own schemas (<exam>-exam@1 and <exam>-why@1, named by the exam definition, docs/ARCHITECTURE.md 3.4): their shapes are the exam's.
